boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Marion-campus settings for quiet work, tutoring, collaborative projects, research, presentations, and between-class study.

cards.title: Build a research session around Jackson Library
cards.subtitle: Library workstations, wireless access, research help, and multimedia resources
cards.notes: Bring a source list and use the workstations, research assistance, or multimedia resources to move a substantial assignment forward.
cards.short_summary: A research-focused setting with print collections, connected workstations, multimedia tools, and librarian support.
cards.evidence_claim: IWU describes Jackson Library as a 79,000-square-foot facility with study, meeting, and research spaces, computer workstations, wireless access, research assistance, and multimedia stations.
cards.access_notes: The public page does not state current building hours or guest-access rules; verify the library schedule and entry requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Save long-form work for the 24-hour lounge
cards.subtitle: A dedicated study area inside Jackson Library
cards.notes: Use this dedicated lounge when a project needs an extended work block, then confirm after-hours entry procedures with library staff.
cards.short_summary: The library’s explicitly documented around-the-clock study setting for extended academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: The university’s library page states that Jackson Library includes spaces for studying, meeting, and research, including a 24-hour study lounge.
cards.access_notes: The lounge is described as 24-hour, but the page does not explain after-hours doors, ID access, holiday exceptions, or guest eligibility; confirm locally.

cards.title: Arrange collaborative work in Room 17
cards.subtitle: Lower-level room with flexible seating and presentation technology
cards.notes: Contact the Director of Library Services before planning a group session, and shape the flexible seating around your task.
cards.short_summary: A schedulable collaborative classroom suited to group discussion and shared visual work.
cards.evidence_claim: IWU’s support documentation identifies Jackson Library Room 17 as a lower-level collaborative classroom with audio-video display technology and flexible seating; scheduling requires contacting the Director of Library Services.
cards.source_title: Jackson Library - Instructional Rooms - Indiana Wesleyan University Support Knowledge Base
cards.access_notes: Scheduling is required through the Director of Library Services. The page does not establish walk-in availability or current reservation windows.

cards.title: Put shared material on the display in Room 05B
cards.subtitle: A documented group-study room with an installed flat-panel display
cards.notes: Check availability before gathering, then bring the correct laptop adapter if your group plans to review slides or documents together.
cards.short_summary: A group-study room whose installed display supports collaborative review and presentation practice.
cards.evidence_claim: IWU’s classroom-technology inventory lists Jackson Library Room 05B as a Group Study Room with an installed flat-panel display to which a laptop would commonly be connected.
cards.source_title: Conference Rooms with Flat Panel Displays - Indiana Wesleyan University Support Knowledge Base
cards.access_notes: The page confirms the room and display but gives no current reservation process, capacity, hours, or user eligibility; verify with Jackson Library.

cards.title: Pair study time with academic support
cards.subtitle: Peer tutoring, coaching, and structured study in Barnes Student Center
cards.notes: Bring a specific course problem and connect your work session with peer tutoring, academic coaching, or structured study support.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative academic-support hub designed for skill-building and guided coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: IWU describes The Learning Center as a central academic-support hub providing a collaborative environment, peer tutoring, academic coaching, and structured study opportunities.
cards.source_title: Center for Academic Thriving | Indiana Wesleyan University
cards.access_notes: Located through the Center for Academic Thriving in Barnes Student Center, Suite 260. The page does not publish drop-in hours or appointment rules.

cards.title: Choose independent or side-by-side work
cards.subtitle: A study-and-connection space in Barnes Student Center Suite 260
cards.notes: Use the lounge for independent work or a parallel study session, and keep the collaborative setting in mind when choosing your task.
cards.short_summary: A flexible lounge explicitly intended for both individual study and working alongside peers.
cards.evidence_claim: IWU states that The Thriving Lounge offers a welcoming space where students can study independently or alongside peers and connect with others.
cards.source_title: Center for Academic Thriving | Indiana Wesleyan University
cards.access_notes: The Center is located in Barnes Student Center, Suite 260. Current lounge hours and visitor eligibility are not stated on the page.

cards.title: Use Beard’s dedicated study room after class
cards.subtitle: An around-the-clock study room in an art and classroom building
cards.notes: Plan a focused work block here when nearby classes or studio work shape your day, and verify the building’s after-hours entry process.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated 24-7 study room within a building serving art studios and general-purpose classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The current IWU academic catalog states that Beard Art Center contains art classrooms and studios, general-purpose classrooms, and a 24-7 Study Room.
cards.source_title: CAS - Instructional Facilities | Indiana Wesleyan University Catalog
cards.access_notes: The room is described as 24-7, but the catalog does not explain ID access, door procedures, academic-break exceptions, or guest access.

cards.title: Settle in for a café study session at McConn
cards.subtitle: A Barnes Student Center gathering place documented for late-night studying
cards.notes: Bring headphones and a self-contained task for the social setting; check current operating hours before relying on it for evening work.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffeehouse with a documented history as both a gathering place and late-night study setting.
cards.evidence_claim: IWU’s history of McConn Coffee Company identifies it as a Barnes Student Center gathering place and a space used for late-night studying and events.
cards.source_title: The Heart of IWU – A History of McConn Coffee Company (1996-Present)
cards.access_notes: The source documents late-night studying historically but does not provide current late hours. Check the current schedule; no purchase-free access claim is made.

cards.title: Use Barnes for between-class academic work
cards.subtitle: A central gathering facility that hosts classes, forums, and research initiatives
cards.notes: Choose a publicly available gathering area for between-class work, and relocate if scheduled classes or campus programming need the space.
cards.short_summary: A large academic and community hub with gathering areas and documented educational programming.
cards.evidence_claim: IWU’s catalog describes Barnes Student Center as a 199,000-square-foot central gathering facility that frequently hosts academic forums, classes, and research initiatives.
cards.source_title: CAS - Instructional Facilities | Indiana Wesleyan University Catalog
cards.access_notes: Use only open common areas. The catalog does not publish current building hours, event closures, or access rules for individual rooms.

cards.entity_name: Don Wood Foundation Hall of Engineering Senior Design and Collaborative Space
cards.title: Bring project work to the engineering collaborative space
cards.subtitle: A specialized setting for senior design and team-based engineering work
cards.notes: Use the space for an authorized engineering project session, and confirm course or division access before bringing a team or equipment.
cards.short_summary: A purpose-built collaborative area supporting engineering design work near technical labs and shops.
cards.evidence_claim: IWU’s catalog states that Don Wood Foundation Hall of Engineering includes dual-use classrooms, engineering labs and shops, and a senior design and collaborative space.
cards.source_title: CAS - Instructional Facilities | Indiana Wesleyan University Catalog
cards.access_notes: The catalog describes a specialized academic facility but does not establish general walk-in access; confirm eligibility and availability with the engineering program.
